title: Chicago Curling Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Founded in 1948, the Chicago Curling Club welcomes all visitors and members. Our facility has four sheets of ice, locker rooms, a fully-equipped kitchen, dining area, and a large social and viewing area. As with all sports, it's the players that make the game, and the members of the Chicago Curling Club have created a warm and welcoming place where you can enjoy a competitive sport and make and expand friendships.
